items.title: Dick Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 1, 2006
items.q: I used to listen Saturday mornings when I was a kid in my mother’s car to Ted Husings’ broadcast of Eddie Condon...

ctx.x: H-U-S-I-N-G. He lost his sight and he continued to broadcast on the radio. And he was a great lover of Eddie Condon and so I used to listen Saturday mornings when I was a kid in my mother’s car to Ted Husings’ broadcast of Eddie Condon, Wild Bill Davison, Cutty Cutshall. And I used to get so excited by that music I wanted to roll myself up into a ball and shove myself into the radio in the dashboard of the car. I just loved it. Oh and the author, the future author.
